BehaviorTree._description: Turns joint k k times clockwise, all joints in one move as fast as the motors allow, then returns every joint to its start position.

GetJointPositions._description: Records where every joint starts: the turns start from here, and the return comes back here.

OffsetVector._description: Subtracts k full turns (2π·k) from the position of joint k: k clockwise turns.

TrapezoidalTrajectory._description: Turns joint k k times clockwise, all joints together, at 90% of the limits of stepit for joint 5, which has the most turns.

FollowJointTrajectory._description: Sends the turns to the trajectory controller.

TrapezoidalTrajectory._description: Returns every joint to its recorded start position, at 90% of the limits of stepit for joint 5, which has 5 turns to undo. The controller starts from its last command, the turns' target.

FollowJointTrajectory._description: Sends the return to the trajectory controller.
